Soccer practice is Saturday at 10:00am at Cedarvale Park. After that, there's Fanous lantern craft on Saturday afternoon. It's free, and Toronto Public Library's page lists it for ages 6-12, so it suits Ada but not Milo. [link-c9bfa2]

I didn't find anything for Milo's age. Saturday looks dry and warm, so a park or playground afternoon would work for them.
